title: Room template (data/rooms/<id>.json; or data/rooms/<id>.txt = just the grid, tags from the id prefix start_/exit_/boss_/key_/treasure_/room_)
description: All templates of a set share one size. Chars: '#' wall, '.' floor, '?' random wall-or-floor, anything else = marker (reported, becomes floor). Border is sealed; doors carved at edge centres.
